tools.name: search_web
tools.description: Live web search: ranked results plus Google's answer box, knowledge graph, people-also-ask and related searches when the Google-backed provider answers. This is a PAID x402 call: $0.01 USDC on Base at GET /api/search. This tool returns the payment resource to call; it does not run the search. Params

tools.name: scrape_url
tools.description: Any web page as clean, LLM-ready markdown, text or html. This is a PAID x402 call: $0.01 USDC on Base at GET /api/scrape. This tool returns the payment resource to call; it does not fetch the page. Params: url (absolute http/https URL, required); format (markdown | text | html, default markdown); ma

tools.name: lookup_wallet
tools.description: Universal address lookup — any address, any chain, auto-detected. Params: address (EVM 0x address or XRPL classic r-address, required); chain (optional EVM history hint: base default, or ethereum). Detects EVM vs XRPL from the format. Returns one normalized envelope: { address, chain, chain_detected

tools.name: resolve_name
tools.description: Bidirectional name <-> address resolution for ENS (name.eth) and Basenames (name.base.eth). Param: q (an ENS/Basename name, an EVM 0x address, or an XRPL r-address, required). Auto-detects direction. Reverse records are forward-verified against the address to stop name spoofing. Returns { query, kin

tools.name: check_entity
tools.description: Entity attribution — what IS this address, not who owns it. Params: address (0x EVM address, required); chain (base default, or ethereum). Returns { address, chain, is_known, label, category }. category is one of sanctioned, mixer, exchange, bridge, dex_router, scam, drainer, phishing, flagged, toke

tools.name: caller_id
tools.description: Should this wallet be answered? For wallet messaging (XMTP, Push), which has no spam filter. Params: address (0x EVM address, required); chain (base default, or ethereum). Composes entity attribution + risk score + on-chain history + forward-verified name into ANSWER | SCREEN | BLOCK with reasons[]

tools.name: health
tools.description: Service health check. No parameters. Returns { ok, service, time, upstream } — confirms the uxus.finance API is reachable. Free.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scrape_url · Private data: lookup_wallet, resolve_name, caller_id · Public sink: resolve_name, caller_id · Destructive: search_web, scrape_url, lookup_wallet.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scrape_url · Private data: lookup_wallet, resolve_name, caller_id · Public sink: resolve_name, caller_id · Destructive: search_web, scrape_url, lookup_wallet

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
